name: Repair rows and scrap actions - manual prepared fixture

steps._note: Prepare damaged owned repairable item. Test Scrap visibility in Creative, Character, Crafting, Loot and quest reward item-detail panels. Check compact material rows and red count with no local or broadcast materials.

Put repair material only in nearby authorized broadcast container. Check count green, activate native Repair, confirm material consumed and durability restored. Disable broadcast permission and confirm unavailable.
